verdict.rationale: Numeral's marketing claims it can 'register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions' and monitor tax exposure in 'all US and global jurisdictions.' Its pricing page also lists live VAT ID validation, which points to some international VAT support. The detailed docs, though, describe nexus thresholds and filings in mostly US-state terms, and no named non-US regime appears anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: any mention of EU OSS/IOSS, UK VAT, Canadian GST/HST or Australian GST; documentation of foreign registration-threshold tracking; evidence of international VAT/GST filing workflows; independent or hands-on corroboration.
